readerNotes.line: In the west the ticked line meets the heavy east west army group boundary near 5.21E 50.16N; the heavy line running west from there along about 50.18N is the 21 and 12 Army Group boundary and was not counted as front. North end where the heavy line comes down near the Maas at about 5.84E; the Westwall hatching near Aachen was not used. The south east end leaves the east edge near Saarlautern; a heavy line running south from there toward Metz looks like a boundary and was not followed. Line thinned to 38 points.
